prompts.full:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: corrected master anatomical hologram for SIMISA's interactive anatomy application.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference only, NOT an anatomy reference: the existing blue hologram has an incorrectly oversized misshapen heart and MUST be anatomically redesigned.
Create ONE premium full-body anterior anatomical render of a healthy adult neutral medical mannequin. Complete figure, crown through both feet, 4% top/bottom margins. Tall 2:3 portrait composition. Body straight, arms separated from torso by 15 degrees, palms forward. Real transparent background with no black rectangle or backdrop, no floor, no UI/text/labels/watermarks. Silhouette should be slim realistic adult proportions, both hands have five fingers, no genital detail.
Render high-end scientific 3D medical illustration: delicate translucent navy-blue soft tissue, crisp restrained ice-cyan rim light, realistically constructed luminous pale-cyan skeleton, very subtle transparent ribcage, slightly translucent teal lung tissue. Avoid bright bloom obscuring contours. Detailed brain inside faint skull, believable joints, pelvis, long bones. Warm muted coral heart and main arteries, blue veins, softer amber abdominal organs for legibility.
ANATOMY PRIORITY: Heart is a compact fist-sized muscular oblique cone centered in the middle mediastinum between lungs, about two thirds to subject LEFT (viewer RIGHT) of midline; not floating entirely in left lung, not hanging low in abdomen, not a round glowing bulb. Base superior, left ventricular apex directed down and subject-left; right ventricle anterior, realistic atrial appendages, coronary grooves. Recognizable single ascending aorta with arch toward subject-left and three superior branches; pulmonary trunk arises anteriorly then bifurcates, superior vena cava enters right atrium on subject-right. These structures should be clear but appropriately small in full-body scale.
Right lung (viewer-left) three lobes and two fissures; left lung (viewer-right) two lobes, cardiac notch. Lungs end on dome of diaphragm. Liver chiefly subject-right (viewer-left), stomach subject-left (viewer-right), colon framing central small bowel. Organs correctly placed, non-overlapping impossible structures avoided. Heart width roughly one third the internal thoracic width, not one whole lung. Do not draw vessels as random tubes or a collection of tentacles.
Match the reference holographic aesthetic while substantially improving anatomical shape, heart proportion and calm detail. This must look like a beautifully art-directed render of a single consistent anatomical model. Native highest useful portrait resolution.

The pulmonary trunk emerges anteriorly and divides to both lungs. Blue superior vena cava on subject-right empties into right atrium. Distinct vessels with believable origins and connections. No extra random pipes, disconnected vessels, oversized atria, bulbous symmetric heart, duplicated arch, invented holes or orange electric veins.
